subject.title: fix(agents): keep bundle LSP tool names provider-safe

question: Should bundled LSP naming preserve every already-valid complete tool name while automatically renaming only unsafe, overlong, reserved, or colliding names?
rationale: That rule is technically sound and minimizes churn, but generated tool names can be referenced by user policy, so accepting the remaining bounded compatibility effect requires owner intent rather than automated judgment.

options.title: Accept the bounded naming rule
options.body: Preserve valid complete names and allow deterministic repair only where the prior name could not safely register or collided with another tool.

options.title: Require a shared naming contract
options.body: Pause merge and first define a generic exported naming helper shared by LSP and MCP, with compatibility tests for both consumers.

options.title: Retain current behavior
options.body: Close the PR and continue rejecting or skipping tools whose configured server keys cannot form safe unique names.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded naming rule
recommendation.body: Preserve valid complete names and allow deterministic repair only where the prior name could not safely register or collided with another tool.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available routing candidate for accepting an agent-runtime compatibility rule spanning provider-facing tool registration.
